what_this_measures: real sm_ml_inference FastAPI app via TestClient (ASGITransport, in-process -- no real OS socket/network hop), real routing+auth+pydantic validation+model lookup+scoring+serialization. NOT the same as scripts/benchmark_inference_latency.py's bare in-process model.score() loop.
